history_records.author: goldislead
history_records.subject: [GPU] Round normalized unsigned fixed fetches

symbols: Round normalized results to 16 fractional bits

history_records.rationale_summary: The commit says two identified titles compare filtered unsigned-fixed samples to Q16 and therefore adds rounding, leaving signed and integer fetches unchanged.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct ancestor of the pinned Canary commit.
limitations: The cited titles are not Fable II.

history_records.author: goldislead
history_records.subject: [Memory/GPU/Kernel] Initial XPS support
history_records.rationale_summary: The commit makes 0x7F000000 a physical heap and wraps L2 addresses in vertex fetch, index and translator paths.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct parent of the pinned Canary commit.
limitations: The commit describes initial support and does not prove Fable II uses XPS.

history_records.author: goldislead
history_records.subject: [GPU] Replace AC6 ground hack with scalar approximation rounding
history_records.rationale_summary: The pinned commit replaces a title-specific workaround with 21-mantissa-bit rounding for a scalar ALU family and explicitly says exact precision and halfway behavior remain unconfirmed.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Pinned Canary commit.
limitations: The hardware model is deliberately not labelled confirmed accuracy.
The affected title examples are not Fable II.

history_records.author: goldislead
history_records.subject: [GPU] Handle tessellated triangle strip and fan draws
history_records.rationale_summary: The commit normalizes strips and fans to triangle lists and creates a runtime conversion buffer when the backend did not bake one.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct ancestor of the pinned Canary commit.
limitations: No Fable II topology evidence accompanies the change.

history_records.author: goldislead
history_records.subject: [GPU] Emulate extended-range float16 in render target pack/unpack
history_records.rationale_summary: The commit states that guest exponent 31 is finite up to 131008 and corrects the previous 65504 clamp and Inf unpack behavior.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct ancestor of the pinned Canary commit.

history_records.author: goldislead
history_records.subject: [GPU] Use EDRAM layout with a single sample addressing scheme
history_records.rationale_summary: The commit supplies canonical 1x/2x/4x addressing equations and explains why all resolves, clears, transfers, dumps and interlock paths changed together.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct ancestor of the pinned Canary commit.
limitations: The commit provides no Fable II pass evidence.

history_records.author: goldislead
history_records.subject: [GPU] Fix base map selection with a separate mip page
history_records.rationale_summary: The commit explains that mip_min_level is sampler state, preserves separate base allocation, clamps its sampler to level zero and identifies a non-Fable regression.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct ancestor of the pinned Canary commit.
limitations: The cited regression title is not Fable II.

history_records.author: Clippy95
history_records.subject: [D3D12] Fix constant-alpha blending in the RTV path
history_records.rationale_summary: The subject identifies the corrected behavior; capability fallback details are established by the source diff, but the commit has no explanatory body.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct ancestor of the pinned Canary commit.
limitations: No issue, PR discussion or title evidence was found in the local history.

history_records.author: goldislead
history_records.subject: [GPU] Select promoted tfetch1D layouts at runtime
history_records.rationale_summary: The commit says runtime selection preserves one title's 2D case while fixing another title's wide 1D bindings.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct ancestor of the pinned Canary commit.
limitations: The cited titles are not Fable II.

history_records.author: Michael Oliver
history_records.subject: [GPU] Avoid stale texture state after invalidation
history_records.rationale_summary: The commit requires backing validity before marking a texture current and installing watches, leaving invalid data outdated for later reload.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct ancestor of the pinned Canary commit.

history_records.author: goldislead
history_records.subject: [GPU] Clamp out-of-bounds vertex fetch words to 0

symbols: Words at or past the end of the fetch buffer

history_records.rationale_summary: The commit states that real hardware returns zero at or beyond the fetch-constant size.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct ancestor of the pinned Canary commit.

history_records.author: goldislead
history_records.subject: [GPU] Scaled resolve readback through downscale CS
history_records.rationale_summary: The commit describes scaled block unpacking, written-extent binding, ResolveInfo authority, alignment/containment checks and tail truncation for D3D12 and Vulkan.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct ancestor of the pinned Canary commit.
limitations: It credits an Edge approach but the audited evidence here is the Canary commit and current source only.

history_records.author: goldislead
history_records.subject: [Memory] Rework guest access resolution and unwatched invalidation
history_records.rationale_summary: The commit explicitly covers system-page permissive access, unwatched write-fault validation and invalidation on unwatched decommit/release/protect-to-writable.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct ancestor of the pinned Canary commit.
limitations: The commit says it combines three Edge commits; those upstream Edge identifiers were not present in the local primary history.

history_records.author: goldislead
history_records.subject: [GPU] Texture integer scaling fetches; 8_8_8_8_GAMMA resolve
history_records.rationale_summary: The commit calls CPU-derived integer scales authoritative, places their translator operation precisely, and separately documents PWL gamma resolve and copy_dest_number packing.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct ancestor of the pinned Canary commit.
limitations: Broad title-fix claims in the commit do not establish Fable II relevance.

history_records.author: SaveEditors
history_records.subject: [GPU] Initialize GPU registers to hardware reset defaults
history_records.rationale_summary: The author records retail-console reset reads corroborated by AMD and Mesa defaults and explains why tessellation factors were intentionally omitted.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct ancestor of the pinned Canary commit.
limitations: Fable's read-before-write behavior is not established.

history_records.author: goldislead
history_records.subject: [GPU] Don’t drop swizzles from dummy texture headers
history_records.rationale_summary: The commit retains declared dimensions when a header requests only literal zero and one swizzles.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct ancestor of the pinned Canary commit.

history_records.author: bomabomabomaboma
history_records.subject: [GPU] Implement ZPD occlusion queries
history_records.rationale_summary: The commit fully describes shared logical reports, cross-submission segments, same-slot reuse, backend query/counter mechanisms, asynchronous retirement and fast/strict/fake modes.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct ancestor of the pinned Canary commit; follow-up cvar and fast-cache commits are also direct ancestors but are not separate matrix behaviors.
limitations: QueryBatch remains fake-only for a configured range.

history_records.author: bomabomabomaboma
history_records.subject: [GPU] Remove num_format/decode cvars and dead shader code
history_records.rationale_summary: The commit removes the num_format/decode switches after describing them as sufficiently exercised and leaves PWL decode enabled for full 8_8_8_8_GAMMA resolves.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct ancestor of the pinned Canary commit.
limitations: The commit's safety/correctness assessment is stated as probable, not demonstrated for Fable II.

history_records.author: goldislead
history_records.subject: Pinned source comment for asynchronous pipeline completion policy

symbols: Draws will be skipped until pipelines are ready

history_records.rationale_summary: The pinned source explicitly says it does not wait at submission end so background threads can continue and frame-time spikes are avoided.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Content is immutable at the pin; the exact origin commit is not identifiable within the 200-commit shallow clone.
limitations: This is primary checked-in source rationale, not an identified origin commit.

history_records.author: Tom
history_records.subject: fix(d3d12): double EndQuery causing device removal on occlusion query disable
history_records.rationale_summary: The body identifies two EndQuery calls for one BeginQuery causing DXGI_ERROR_INVALID_CALL and documents the state-clear ordering fix.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct ancestor of the pinned ReXGlue commit.
limitations: This is a ReXGlue local robustness fix, not evidence that its full ZPD model matches hardware.

history_records.author: Tom
history_records.subject: feat(graphics): split GraphicsSystem::Setup into presentation and guest-GPU phases
history_records.rationale_summary: The subject explicitly records the phase split; it does not claim a guest-visible correction.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct ancestor of the pinned ReXGlue commit.

history_records.author: Tom
history_records.subject: feat(system): route kernel and app GPU access through IGraphicsSystem
history_records.rationale_summary: The subject and diff directly establish the IGraphicsSystem routing change.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct ancestor of the pinned ReXGlue commit.
limitations: No explanatory body or guest-visible claim is present.

history_records.author: Rien G
history_records.subject: feat(gpu): Vulkan-Xenos implementation to run with MoltenVK
history_records.rationale_summary: The commit records MoltenVK-specific shader, culling, texture fallback and runtime packaging work.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct ancestor of the pinned ReXGlue commit.
limitations: Vulkan is excluded from the exact Fable GPU DLL.

history_records.author: Tom
history_records.subject: fix(gpu): drop the double-buffered page valid flags so frame-end refresh is coherent
history_records.rationale_summary: The subject explicitly ties removal of the double buffer to coherent frame-end refresh and references ReXGlue issue 341.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct ancestor of the pinned ReXGlue commit.
limitations: Issue 341 was not required to interpret the explicit commit rationale.

history_records.author: Tom
history_records.subject: refactor(gpu): remove snappy and the GPU trace capture system
history_records.rationale_summary: The body says the trace system was only partially intact, had no working viewers and directs this capture use to Xenia.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct ancestor of the pinned ReXGlue commit.
limitations: This is diagnostic capability, not guest semantics.

history_records.author: Mystixor
history_records.subject: fix(gpu): correct pacing for guest vblank counter
history_records.rationale_summary: The subject and diff establish catch-up pacing for the guest vblank counter.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct ancestor of the pinned ReXGlue commit.
limitations: The broader divergence from Canary's limiter ancestry is not established.

history_records.author: bomabomabomaboma
history_records.subject: fix(gpu): Update outdated ZPD sentinel pairwise assumption
history_records.rationale_summary: The subject and diff directly change the outdated pairwise sentinel test.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct ancestor of the pinned ReXGlue commit.
limitations: No broader query-lifecycle rationale is supplied.

history_records.author: Tom
history_records.subject: refactor(gpu): add cvar to gate premasking scaled resolve L2 blocks
history_records.rationale_summary: The body says the CVar addresses an Armored Core For Answer USA issue.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct ancestor of the pinned ReXGlue commit.
limitations: The cited title is not Fable II and the CVar does not explain Canary's later scaled-readback design.

history_records.author: Tom
history_records.subject: feat(gpu)!: extract Xenos GPU emulation into runtime loaded rexgpu-xenos plugin
history_records.rationale_summary: The subject and diff directly establish plugin extraction and runtime loading.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct ancestor of the pinned ReXGlue commit.
limitations: No guest-semantic claim is present.

history_records.author: Ryan Fisher
history_records.subject: graphics/d3d12: port backend pipeline and command runtime updates
history_records.rationale_summary: The subject establishes that backend updates were ported, but does not identify the source revision or explain the query design intent.
history_records.ancestry_relationship: Direct ancestor of the pinned ReXGlue commit.
limitations: Port origin and exact ancestry are not identified by this commit.
